SASBDB entry SASDM76  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDM76/)

Publication: Long promoter sequences form higher-order G-quadruplexes: an integrative structural biology study of c-Myc, k-Ras and c-Kit promoter sequences.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkac182

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDM76/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
